Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.mfa

Class JdbcTrustedDeviceRepository

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.mfa.JdbcTrustedDeviceRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
TrustedDeviceRepository
@Repository public class JdbcTrustedDeviceRepository extends Object implements TrustedDeviceRepository
TrustedDeviceRepository over the trusted_devices table. It joins the transaction of its caller.
